product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Indoor Small Area Rug, Jute Backed, Perfect for Entryway, Office, Living/Dining Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Modern Geometric Patchwork Floor Decor, Clifton Collection, 2' x 3', Grey/Brown
features: DURABLE and COMFORTABLE: Woven and crafted with 100% Polypropylene fibers and a cozy, 0.31” pile height which can endure frequented areas of your home while remaining ultra-plush; OEKO-TEX Certified to ensure environmental and safety standards
WIDE VARIETY: Available in in an asssortment of colors and sizes to make a tailored fit for any room in your home; Colors include: Grey/ Brown, Grey, Rivulet, Ginger
STYLE FAVORITE: Clifton displays a striking, modern color-blocked patchwork design; well-made with a durable jute backing; instantly elevate the beauty of your floors with this gorgeous rug
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Vacuum regularly and spot clean. Rug pad recommended (sold separately) to avoid slippage. Use scissors to remove any loose ends. Turn occasionally to equalize wear.

PERFECT GIFT: Our products are backed by loyal guest service; our designs match a variety of styles and make great gifts; perfect for bridal, house-warming, or any holiday; update any room in your home, dorm, or apartment in an instant
description: Add an exciting update to your floors with the Clifton Area Rug. Crafted from exceptional, 100% Polypropylene fibers with a firm jute backing, and boasting a 0.31” pile height, this rug has a plush feel that can handle high traffic rooms in your home. Accent any living room, dining room, or foyer with Clifton’s modern design. Available in rivulet with a bold color-block patchwork pattern, updating the look of your tile or hardwood floors is effortless. The premium craftsmanship, soothing color, and bold geometric appearance of this rug make it an essential, long-lasting piece you’ll enjoy for years.

details.Product Care Instructions: Vacuum regularly to prevent dust and crumbs from setting into the fibers. Avoid continuous exposure to sunlight. Use scissors to remove any loose ends. Turn from time to time to equalize wear. Spot clean for best results
